expected.support_text: M16 appeared at 53.9 min and was identified as a GSH conjugate. CID of the M16 ion at m/z 837 produced fragment ions at m/z 748 and m/z 708. The product ion at m/z 708 resulted from loss of the pyroglutamic acid moiety (129 Da), consistent with GSH conjugate formation. LC-MS/MS screening for GSH conjugates used constant neutral loss scan of ions that lost 129 Da.
expected.qualifying_conditions: Formed from INF metabolites via 1,4-benzoquinone intermediate; requires metabolic bioactivation
expected.experimental_conditions: In vitro metabolism using rat or human liver microsomes with GSH; LC-MS/MS with positive ion mode, constant neutral loss of 129 Da; M16 retention time 53.9 min; parent ion m/z 837, fragment ions at m/z 748 and m/z 708
expected.extra_details: The fragment at m/z 708 results from loss of pyroglutamic acid (129 Da), confirming GSH conjugation.
